popCulture.title: Iliad
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Book II and V — Tlepolemus leads the Rhodians, boasts his Heraclid blood to Sarpedon, and dies by the Lycian's spear.

popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus' Heraclid exile — Tlepolemus kills Licymnius, flees to Rhodes, and founds the three Rhodian cities.

popCulture.title: Tlepolemus
popCulture.description: Son of Heracles who colonizes Rhodes — Iliadic captain and eponym of Rhodian Heraclid kingship.
